headings.instruction: Replace Barlow Condensed with Outfit in the classic theme. Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for all headings to achieve the premium startup look. Apply font-display or font-outfit class.

body.instruction: Keep Inter for body text. Ensure text colors are muted (text-zinc-400) to create stark contrast with white headings.

accent.instruction: Primary CTAs must be Pure White bg with Black text. The LordTraining Gold (#D4AF37) is used for premium highlights, icons, or the active state to match the logo. The legacy Neon Lime (#A3E635) is heavily restrained, used ONLY for micro-indicators like success dots or chart data lines.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Remove all heavy neon glows. Use subtle ambient lighting: shadow-[0_4px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] or an extremely faint white glow shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.03)].
visual_enhancers.borders: Adopt a Technical Grid Look. 1px borders using border-white/10 on almost all cards, buttons, and sections.
visual_enhancers.radii: Restrained roundness. Use rounded-xl for main bento cards, rounded-lg for buttons and smaller inputs.
visual_enhancers.background_effects: Use a subtle radial gradient in the Hero background to simulate a spotlight: bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-zinc-800/20 via-zinc-950 to-zinc-950.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. For bento grids, use gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.bento_grid: For Features and Scouting, use pure HTML/Tailwind bento grids with direct children elements. Mix col-span-1 and col-span-2 for asymmetry.
layouts.alignment: Left-align mostly. Center-align the Hero text, but keep feature descriptions and scouting points strictly left-aligned.

motion.hover_states: Cards should have a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and an increase in border opacity (border-white/20).
motion.buttons: Scale down slightly on active (active:scale-95). Transition transform and background-color over 0.2s ease.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Extremely slow speed (20-30). Text must be low contrast (text-zinc-800) so it acts as texture, not a distraction.

sections_blueprint.1_Navbar: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/70. 1px bottom border border-white/5. 'Iniciar Sesión' -> text-zinc-300 hover:text-white. 'Crear Cuenta' -> bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 rounded-full px-4 py-2.
sections_blueprint.2_Hero: Spotlight background. Headline: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-semibold tracking-tighter text-white. Subtitle: text-lg text-zinc-400 max-w-2xl mx-auto. CTAs: Primary white, Secondary outline transparent. Right side dashboard: 1px border, bg-zinc-900/50, restrained lime/gold data lines.
sections_blueprint.3_Scouting_New: Bento-style layout. Title left-aligned. 'Pills' for audiences (rounded-full border border-white/10 text-xs). 6 benefits as a list with subtle gold checkmarks. Floating cards on the scout image using framer-motion.
sections_blueprint.4_Marquee_Sports: Editorial Ribbon. text-4xl font-bold text-zinc-800 uppercase tracking-widest. Slow drift.
sections_blueprint.5_Multi_Sport: Cards with bg-zinc-900/30, border border-white/5. Grayscale SVG pitches that colorize (subtle tint) on hover.
sections_blueprint.6_Features_Bento: Classic Linear-style Bento Grid. Mix tall and wide cards. Inner padding p-8. Use Lucide icons tinted with gold or white.
sections_blueprint.7_Audiences_Trust: Logos strictly grayscale opacity-40 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity.
sections_blueprint.8_How_It_Works: Vertical timeline. Line is border-l border-white/10. Steps have a white/10 dot that glows white on hover.
sections_blueprint.9_Pricing: 3 columns. Monthly/Annual toggle is a pill shape bg-zinc-900 p-1. Center 'Pro' card has border-white/20 and a subtle radial gradient background to pop out.
sections_blueprint.10_Testimonials: Horizontal scroll or grid. Cards bg-zinc-900/40, border border-white/5. Client names in white, roles in zinc-500.
sections_blueprint.11_Footer: Massive py-32. Huge 'LORDTRAINING' watermark text at the very bottom text-[10vw] text-zinc-900. Links in zinc-400 hover:white.

image_urls.description: Coach holding tactics board. Use as background or context image if custom SVG is missing.
Sports data analytics on screen. Use for analytics feature card.
Dark stadium lights. Ideal for a moody, high-end hero background overlay.

3d_libraries.instruction: Framer Motion is sufficient for UI transitions and floating scouting cards. Do not introduce Three.js or heavy 3D unless specifically replacing the hero data viz.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on dark backgrounds meets APCA standards. Muted text should not drop below text-zinc-500. Use text-white for primary information.
accessibility.interactive: All buttons, tabs, and toggles must have visible focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white/20 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='cta-hero-register').

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT do a structural rewrite of LandingPage.js. Map these styles strictly to the existing sections and elements.
Modify CSS variables in landingThemes.css for the 'classic' theme: e.g., --bg-color: #09090b, --primary-color: #ffffff.
Use Tailwind utility classes directly in the JSX for specific overrides (like tracking-tight, backdrop-blur-xl).
Replace Barlow Condensed with Outfit. Add Google Font link if needed, or update tailwind config.
Ensure 't(...)' i18n calls are strictly untouched.
Add data-testid attributes to all CTAs and interactive elements to facilitate robust automated testing.
Do not use complete transparent background in header. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/70.
Apply styles to .js files only as this is a React JS project.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Maintain all component logical structures and React hooks.
Do not break any existing feature toggles or multilinguism.
Embrace 'Tactical Minimalism': Dark surfaces, pure white typography, hair-line borders, and zero muddy gradients.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
